title: Fault finding: the LED that stays dark
intro: A 5 V supply, a switch, a 330 Ω resistor and a red LED in series. The switch is on, but the LED stays dark: one thing on this board is faulty. Measure, think about what each reading rules out, then name the fault.
dxSwitch: The switch does not make contact
dxRDrift: The resistor has the wrong value (far too high)
dxTrace: The copper track between the resistor and the LED is broken
dxLedReversed: The LED is soldered the wrong way round
